data.action: 盘坐在宣纸中央，手持毛笔悬停沉思，墨龙与山峦从纸面逸出
data.camera: dynamic wide angle, swirling ink dragons, traditional calligraphy aura
data.description: 【夕 · 画室】堆满万卷水墨长卷与陈年松烟墨锭的画室内，夕赤足盘坐于铺展的宣纸中央，提笔悬停在半空沉思。她回过头斜睨着走近的你，语气傲娇而慵懒——「吵死了……难得有点作画的灵感全被你的脚步声打乱了。罚你坐在这儿给我研墨三个时辰，不准乱动。」
data.lighting: 泼洒的水墨泛着幽冷青蓝微光与金箔碎屑，如梦似幻的东方奇幻大片感
data.promptProse: Dusk sits cross-legged on the enormous sheet of studio rice paper, her brush suspended as dripping ink gives rise to faint dragons and mountain silhouettes. Preserve the ink-gray mascot hoodie, lounge shorts and messy brush-held bun, with her horns and tail clearly separated from the nearby scrolls. In the wide dynamic view, the nearest ink stick and rolled scroll overlap the paper edge; beyond her, successive ink-painted mountain forms become paler and smaller within the unfolding picture-world. Cold blue lantern light illuminates her sleeves and the paper grain. The brush casts a long narrow shadow across the sheet, while subtle golden flecks remain localized near the emerging ink forms.
data.title: 夕 · 泼墨画卷·万千水墨腾空起
